seoTitle: Baltimore County School Calendar 2025-2026: Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: See the BCPS 2025-2026 Pre-Labor Day calendar with first day, last scheduled day, holidays, breaks, early closings, makeup days, official PDF and ICS download.
heroSummary: Baltimore County Public Schools begins the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 25, 2025. If no emergency closure days are used, the school year ends for students on Thursday, June 11, 2026. Spring break runs March 23-29, with schools reopening Monday, March 30.
heroSummaryFacts: 183 elementary student days / 184 secondary student days
calendarNotes: BCPS begins the 2025-2026 Pre-Labor Day Start calendar on August 25, 2025, before Labor Day. The official calendar lists the first full day of kindergarten separately, which matters for families with kindergarten students. Thanksgiving break is a short closure on November 27-28 after a three-hour early closing on November 26. Spring break begins at the end of the school day on March 20, with student no-school days running March 23-29 and schools reopening Monday, March 30. If no emergency closure days occur, BCPS states that the school year ends for students on June 11, 2026. The listed emergency closure makeup days are June 12, June 15, and June 16, 2026, and the district notes that additional closures may lead to virtual learning or further calendar adjustments.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Baltimore County Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Baltimore County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 25, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last scheduled day for BCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: If no emergency closure days are used, BCPS states that the school year ends for students on Thursday, June 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is BCPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break begins at the end of the school day on Friday, March 20, 2026. Student no-school days run March 23-29, and schools reopen Monday, March 30, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the BCPS emergency closure makeup days in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists June 12, June 15, and June 16, 2026 as emergency closure makeup days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first full day of kindergarten in BCPS 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first full day of kindergarten is listed separately from opening day. Families should confirm kindergarten transportation timing directly with BCPS or their assigned school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2025-2026 BCPS calendar include early-closing days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The calendar lists several three-hour early closings for students, including October 31, November 14, November 26, January 16, February 20, March 20, June 12, June 15, and June 16.
